documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Manage the documents in this knowledge base. Supported formats: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, ODT, ODP, CSV, XLSX, XLS, ODS, TXT, EML, MSG and audio.
documents.empty: No documents uploaded yet. Upload a PDF, DOCX or ODT file to get started.

documents.uploadError: Failed to upload document. Please try again.
documents.urlDialogDescription: Enter the URL of a website to import its content into the knowledge base.

documents.addUrlError: Failed to add URL. Please check the URL and try again.
documents.addUrlRetrievalFailed: The website could not be reached. Please check that the URL is correct and the website is accessible.

confirmRemoveFailed.description_one: {{count}} document could not be processed. It will be removed from this knowledge base. This cannot be undone.
confirmRemoveFailed.description_other: {{count}} documents could not be processed. They will be removed from this knowledge base. This cannot be undone.

documents.removeFailedError: Failed documents could not be removed. Please try again.

processingErrors.failed: The file could not be processed. Upload it again. If the problem persists, contact support.
processingErrors.unreadable: Couldn’t read this file. Upload it again.
processingErrors.empty: No text could be read from the document. Use a more legible version and upload it again.
processingErrors.timeout: Document processing timed out. Splitting large documents may help; upload the file again afterwards.
processingErrors.tooManyPages: The document has too many pages. Split it into smaller files and upload those.
processingErrors.recordingTooLong: The recording is too long to transcribe. Split it into shorter parts and upload them separately.
processingErrors.spreadsheetTooLarge: The spreadsheet is too large. Remove unused rows and columns or split it into smaller files, then upload it again.
processingErrors.unavailable: The document processing service is temporarily unavailable. Upload the file again later.

syncedLocations.description: Files from SharePoint, kept up to date every hour. Everyone with access to this knowledge base sees them according to its sharing in Ayunis, not according to SharePoint permissions.

syncedLocations.accessNote: Everyone with access to this knowledge base sees the synced files according to its sharing in Ayunis, not according to SharePoint permissions.

status.noLongerAccessible: No longer accessible to Ayunis. Its documents stay until you remove the source.
